name: Semaphore
summary: Semaphore bills by the minute for the machine a job uses, with $15 of free credit each month. An Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minute costs $0.0075, an ARM 2-vCPU minute $0.003 and a self-hosted minute $0.0025. Support and success plans are optional add-ons.

facts.text: The $15 monthly credit is about 2,000 Ubuntu x64 2-vCPU minutes and can be used across services.
Artifacts include 100 GB of storage and 20 GB of egress a month, then cost $0.07 per GB stored and $0.35 per GB of egress.
Promotions chain pipelines for continuous delivery, and can be manual, automatic or parameterized, with deployment targets for access control.
The jobs page covers debugging with SSH sessions, attaching to a running job and port forwarding.

plans.name: Ubuntu ARM 2 vCPU
plans.notes: 4 vCPU is $0.006 and 8 vCPU is $0.012 per minute

hiddenCosts: A dedicated cache server and a private Docker registry each cost $400 a month.
Support plans run from $50 to $750 a month, and success plans from $125 to $2,000 a month.
Engineering access is sold in one-time packages from $900 for 3 hours.
